intent: Ten UI concept images, not an implemented or device-qualified UI
sample_values: 1,240 credits and 42/60 captures are illustrative, not actual account data.

concepts.name: Atomic Pulp
concepts.direction: 1950s invasion posters, Googie roadside signs and friendly rubber-suit creature cinema. Cobalt enamel UI plates, butter-yellow atomic starbursts, coral keylines and mint beam glow. Giant charismatic retro slanted title with orbital swash near top. Bottom START RUN is one broad flying-saucer-shaped enamel button; location is a compact cream destination sign above it; Hangar and Settings are paired small engraved icon buttons. Restrained asymmetry, thick legible geometric letters, subtle screen-printed imperfection only on decorative edges. Improvement focus: immediate unmistakable action hierarchy and fun character.
concepts.intended_improvement: Clear primary action and retro charm.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished portrait mobile game HOME SCREEN concept image, full bleed, no phone hardware, no surrounding presentation board, no extra panels or variants. Edit the supplied current Human Resources home-screen screenshot. Preserve the existing charming low-poly overhead sage-green farmland, farmer, cow, trees, red barn, recognizable cobalt blue UFO with mint lights, and central abduction scene; do not replace this with a spaceship interior, horror illustration or a different game. Remove the old flat UI and redesign the entire UI overlay in the specified visual language. This is a HOME MENU, not gameplay: no HP bars, level HUD, virtual joystick, combat buttons or countdowns. Keep at least the central 45 percent of screen substantially open so the UFO and cow read clearly. All functional UI must be crisp, large, intentional and comfortably tappable, with mobile safe space at top/bottom. Essential exact readable text: title "HUMAN RESOURCES"; largest lower-screen action "START RUN"; location selector "FARMLAND" with left/right arrows; secondary "HANGAR" and "SETTINGS"; compact counter "1,240" labelled "RESEARCH CREDITS"; small optional goal "NEXT BLUEPRINT" / "42 / 60 CAPTURES". Put the credits and goal in small calm UI areas, keep 4 primary controls easy to identify. No additional currencies, shop, season pass, daily reward, energy, lootbox or online/social functions. Use a distinctive genre-aware title treatment inspired by the current punchy slanted cream logo, very legible control text and consistent custom icons, not generic web dashboard cards. Tone is FUN, mischievous, alien abduction workplace comedy for teens/adults, not gore. Preserve game geometry/art direction as far as possible; the new visual style belongs mainly to the UI. Deliver sharp professional game art direction.
STYLE DIRECTION: 1950s invasion posters, Googie roadside signs and friendly rubber-suit creature cinema. Cobalt enamel UI plates, butter-yellow atomic starbursts, coral keylines and mint beam glow. Giant charismatic retro slanted title with orbital swash near top. Bottom START RUN is one broad flying-saucer-shaped enamel button; location is a compact cream destination sign above it; Hangar and Settings are paired small engraved icon buttons. Restrained asymmetry, thick legible geometric letters, subtle screen-printed imperfection only on decorative edges. Improvement focus: immediate unmistakable action hierarchy and fun character.

concepts.name: Analog Signal
concepts.direction: 1970s practical spaceship computer terminals and quirky surveillance cinema. Charcoal-green smoked CRT panels only at upper and lower edges, warm phosphor mint text, amber chunky hardware tabs, off-white utilitarian lettering, tactile hardware corner screws used sparsely. Avoid whole-screen scanlines; scene stays daylight green and clear. Title is a compact cream stencilled header. Counter and blueprint progress grouped into one slim top telemetry strip. START RUN is an enormous amber physical switch strip with tiny triangular launch indicator; paired Hangar and Settings are labelled hardware keys. FARMLAND as a two-arrow destination tape immediately above launch. Improvement over first: better grouping of secondary information, with less competition for Start.
concepts.intended_improvement: Groups secondary information into a telemetry rail.

concepts.name: Invasion Comic
concepts.direction: Mid-century alien anthology comics and irreverent Saturday-morning sci-fi. Strong black ink borders, cream caption blocks, restrained halftone, acid yellow and vivid coral on cobalt. Title in an explosive carefully composed comic masthead at top, UI only in inked comic captions leaving the low-poly environment unchanged. START RUN in a bold clean yellow angled action panel at bottom; Hangar/Settings are two distinct cream panels below, all large crisp lettering. Farmland selector in an illustrated location caption with cow pictogram. One tiny speech bubble from cow reading 'MOO?' allowed; no clutter of sound effects. Improvement over CRT: stronger small-screen readability using decisive graphic silhouettes and text contrast.
concepts.intended_improvement: Stronger graphic silhouettes and text contrast.

concepts.name: Classified Dossier
concepts.direction: Playful UFO conspiracy files, government case folders and deadpan alien-investigation cinema. UI built from clean ivory dossier tabs, midnight-navy rubber-stamp headings, selective red classification stamps and mint active-state ink. Upper logo is a dramatic official HUMAN RESOURCES stamp; slim Research Credits evidence ticket. Lower UI arranged as a tidy open file folder margin, with FARMLAND as selected case tab, START RUN as dominant navy stamped authorization button, Hangar/Settings as two labelled file-index buttons. Small NEXT BLUEPRINT caption is framed as one active research case, not a task list. No illegible paperwork or fake tiny paragraphs. Improvement over comic: cleaner separation between primary action and optional progression.
concepts.intended_improvement: Separates starting a run from optional progression.

concepts.name: Living Biotech
concepts.direction: Friendly organic spacecraft interfaces from imaginative creature cinema and cosmic comics. Deep plum and cobalt soft-shell biomorphic frames, pearl text, luminous mint gel lenses with tiny coral organic accents. UI is grown rather than manufactured: softly asymmetric rounded lobes, inflated membranes, beautiful polished organic material, but never slime obscuring letters. The farmland remains the same low-poly daylight world. A compact sculpted alien title at top, credits in a small pearl capsule, one huge lower mint gel START RUN pad, Farmland selector as three connected organic destination lobes with Farmland selected; broad tactile Hangar/Settings lobes below. Improvement over dossier: more inviting tactile affordances and exceptionally generous thumb-friendly targets.
concepts.intended_improvement: Inviting tactile controls with broad targets.

concepts.name: Department of Abductions
concepts.direction: The strongest final direction: an original deadpan ALIEN HUMAN-RESOURCES DEPARTMENT interface, combining friendly interstellar bureaucracy from sci-fi film, crisp satirical comic title craft and tactile retro industrial design. Avoid copying previous layouts literally. Preserve the actual low-poly farmland background and original blue saucer as hero; broad central clear window, no real spacecraft interior.
